# DocMergeForge Support

For installation, usage, troubleshooting, recovery, fidelity, accessibility, packaging, and privacy-safe support guidance, see [`docs/support.md`](../docs/support.md).

Before opening a public issue, remove passwords, tokens, confidential manuscript content, private recovery files, and sensitive local paths from screenshots, logs, diagnostics, and example projects.

Use the repository bug/feature issue forms for public, reproducible project work. Security-sensitive vulnerabilities must follow [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) instead of being posted publicly.
